estimand.parameter: Mean score at or above the cutoff minus mean score below the cutoff
estimand.estimator: Difference between the two independent-group sample means
estimand.standard_interval: Welch t interval using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

mri_grouping.source: Pooled median in the Phase 2 status_and_mri sample
mri_grouping.comparison_order: At or above cutoff minus below cutoff
mri_grouping.ties: Include values equal to the cutoff in the at-or-above group
mri_grouping.bootstrap_rule: Keep the cutoff fixed across bootstrap draws

method.name: Two-sided independent-samples Welch t test
method.confidence_interval: Welch t interval using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
method.standard_error: sqrt(s_higher^2 / n_higher + s_lower^2 / n_lower), using sample variances with n - 1 denominators

assumptions.independence: Each participant contributes to one MRI group. The sampling model treats different participants as independent.
assumptions.large_sample: Group means use the large-sample Welch approximation. Individual score distributions need not be exactly normal.
assumptions.variances: The method allows unequal population variances and unequal group sizes.
assumptions.value_rules: Reuse the Phase 1 usability rules and sample flags. Retain measurements outside IQR review fences.
assumptions.cutoff: Inference is conditional on the fixed Phase 2 cutoff; uncertainty in selecting that cutoff is not propagated.

method.scope: Unadjusted exploratory comparison among eligible participants with normal cognition

hypothesis_test.role: Main Phase 3 cross-modal contrast in the normal-cognition sample
hypothesis_test.null: The mean score difference between the MRI groups is zero
hypothesis_test.alternative: The mean score difference between the MRI groups is nonzero
hypothesis_test.effect: Raw difference in mean score with its confidence interval

multiplicity.adjustment: Holm adjustment across the two planned tests
multiplicity.reporting: Report the test statistic, degrees of freedom, raw p-value and Holm-adjusted p-value
multiplicity.status: Pending the supplementary thickness-by-status test in Step 6. Calculate Holm adjustment once both planned raw p-values are available.

diagnostics.group_distributions: Group summaries include the score range, quartiles, sample SD and IQR review counts; all flagged values are retained.
diagnostics.group_sizes: Both group counts are checked against the saved plan before testing.
diagnostics.pairing: Linked UDS and MRI records belong to the same person. The two MRI groups contain different people, so the contrast uses independent groups.

interpretation.confidence_interval: Under repeated sampling with the stated assumptions, a nominal 95% procedure covers the target population parameter in about 95% of repeated samples.
interpretation.p_value: Under the null hypothesis and test assumptions, the probability of a test statistic at least as incompatible with the null as the observed statistic.
interpretation.effect_units: The mean difference and its interval are in correct animal names in 60 seconds, higher MRI group minus lower MRI group.
interpretation.generalization: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.
interpretation.scope: The contrast describes an unadjusted association. Age, sex and education are addressed in Phase 4.
interpretation.practical_importance: Interpret the effect and its interval in score units. A practical equivalence margin has not been specified.
